aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer; staging criteria were not specified in the abstract.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: These carotenoids were not associated with the risk of localized disease but were inversely associated with the risk of advanced disease.
study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition cohort.
reason: The abstract reports overall incident prostate cancer analyses and separate analyses of advanced incident disease. The source cohort included 137,001 men, but the analytic nested case-control sample comprised 966 cases and 1,064 controls; because a total analytic N is not stated directly, it is left null.
